description: Mounty lives in the menu bar and handles volumes: disks, disk images, and network shares mount and unmount from one quiet popover.
It is menu-bar only — no Dock icon — with in-app Sparkle updates and a Settings window for the details. Built with SwiftUI, Liquid Glass on macOS 26 with a material fallback underneath.
